name: Color-Coupled Correlation Clustering (C4)
description: Chromatic Correlation Clustering (CCC) extends Correlation Clustering by assigning semantic colors to edges and requiring each cluster to receive a single color label. Unlike standard CC, whose LP relaxation has integrality gap 2 on complete graphs and admits a 2.06-approximation, the analogous LP for CCC has a strict lower bound of 2.11, and the best known LP-rounding algorithm achieves 2.15. We explain this gap by isolating the source of difficulty: cross-edge chromatic interference.
